content.statement: The Directive Principles of State Policy are not enforceable by any court, yet are fundamental in the governance of the country and are to be applied by the State in making laws.
content.development: Textual rule in Article 37 of the Constitution of India.
content.application: First filter for any pleading that appears to claim a pure Part IV right.
exceptions: Does not prevent Part III challenges
Does not prevent reliance on implementing statutes
